非人・穢多（ひにん・えた）

Category label for the outcast population: 非人 sits in the label slot (y1085-1231) and 穢多 one blank character slot below it (y1339-1485), both on the same column axis (glyph centres 2684/2680/2680/2677), so the four glyphs form one column. The counts printed to its lower left are this category's. The column stands right of the ○一關藩 marker, so it belongs to the preceding domain, Izushi. One refinement on the proposer's account: Izushi's main fascicle-1 register ends on the preceding leaf (upper_p027_left, printed page 29), where a second maru-marker ○追補（出石藩）— 'Supplement (Izushi Domain)' — opens a separate supplementary return. This leaf continues that supplement, so the owner is Izushi but the block is its 追補, not its home-territory register.

Population of the Toki-district holding: 5,788 persons. Eleven glyphs, 人(1094-1154) 口(1183-1233) 五(1346-1401) 千(1430-1486) 七(1513-1570) 百(1595-1657) 八(1682-1739) 拾(1762-1824) 八(1849-1904) 人(1932-1987) 内(2014-2056); the box encloses the structural 内 ('of which') rather than boxing it alone. The printed total does not close. The male and female runs below give 5,690, so the total exceeds its own components by 98. I re-read every digit at eight-times magnification and compared the two ambiguous characters against a confirmed 八 and a confirmed 六 elsewhere on the page: the total is 五千七百八拾八 (eight glyphs, so no seven-glyph reading such as 五千六百九拾 is available), and the components are 貳千八百八拾九 and 貳千八百壹. Adding the three status groups printed below (24 + 27 + 20 = 71) gives 5,761 and still leaves a gap. The discrepancy is in the print, not in the reading. Izushi Domain's supplementary return.

男貳千八百八拾九人
男（おとこ）二千八百八十九人

Male population of the Toki-district holding: 2,889 persons. Right-hand run of the side-by-side split under 内, sharing its top row (y2084) with the female run. Nine glyphs: 男(2084-2127) 貳(2151-2197) 千(2220-2262) 八(2290-2329) 百(2357-2400) 八(2425-2460) 拾(2493-2538) 九(2562-2607) 人(2632-2675). The two characters that would change the value most were cropped singly at eight times and both are 八, not 九, so the alternative reading 貳千九百八拾七人 (2,987), which would have closed the sum against the printed 5,788, is ruled out. Izushi Domain's supplementary return.
美濃土岐郡男（出石藩分）
女貳千八百壹人
女（おんな）二千八百一人

Female population of the Toki-district holding: 2,801 persons. Left-hand run of the split, seven glyphs: 女(2083-2128) 貳(2151-2197) 千(2219-2261) 八(2291-2331) 百(2357-2398) 壹(2423-2469) 人(2494-2538). The run ends at y2538 while the male run continues to y2675, which confirms seven glyphs against the male run's nine, so a nine-glyph reading such as 貳千八百九拾九人 (2,899) is not available. 壹 was cropped singly at eight times and is unmistakable. With the 2,889 males this gives 5,690, ninety-eight fewer than the printed total. Izushi Domain's supplementary return.

The corresponding header on the preceding leaf reads 藩制一覽表第一（出石）, which confirms that HI names the current domain rather than the page's majority owner.
